_source: Built-in claude.ai QuickBooks connector outputs observed 2026-10-16 with read-only calls (Seb approved), against the company that connector is attached to (not Stratify Software Canada Inc.). Structure only; every value here is a type placeholder.
company_info: plain text, exactly two lines: 'Company Name: <name>' and 'Industry: <NAICS code or name, or Unknown>'

_text_variants.shape: MCP content blocks: (1) a markdown line '**[View in QuickBooks](<reportLink>)**' plus an instruction to present it verbatim; (2) markdown body starting 'STATUS: success', then '## <Report title>', a bold header line (period, accounting method, or company plus period), '### Summary' bullet list of key totals, '### Line Items' as a markdown table (Account | Amount, indentation as   pairs) or a fenced text block (P&L), optional '### Monthly Breakdown' table, then '**Next steps to try:**' numbered list; (3) an italic instruction to present the table exactly and not compute new figures.

cells.name: column key, e.g. ACCOUNT_NAME, DETAIL_NATURAL_HOME_AMOUNT__TOTAL, Customer, Current, 1-30, ...

report_widget_json.summary: report-specific totals object (balance sheet: totalAssets/totalLiabilities/totalEquity/assetBreakdown/liabilityBreakdown/ratios; AR aging: totalReceivables/totalOverdue/totalCurrent/overduePercent/bucketTotals/customerCount/topOverdueCustomers/customersByBucket/metricCards)
report_widget_json.reportLink: url to the report in QuickBooks

_not_observed: match objects (no matches in this company for the probes used), create_* outputs, and the widget/text shapes of the other reports; follow the same patterns.
